cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
s: A premium performance, flexible class III, ready to use, water based polyurethane waterproofing membrane designed for internal and external areas including wet areas, balconies, terraces, and non UV exposed above ground external applications.
SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof is a suitable undertile waterproofing membrane that complies to AS/NZS 4654:2012 and AS 4858:2004.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Uses
cl.l: SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof is suitable for use on walls and floors for both internal and external applications including under pedistall and paver applications. SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof is suitable for most typical construction substrates such as.
s: Concrete
GRC - Glass reinforced concrete
Cement boards and sheets including Scyon
Renders and screeds
Cement coated light weight construction boards
Plasterboard
Structural Plywood
Autoclaved Aerated Concrete (AAC)

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2026, Version 02.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality
s: All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material.
Prior to application, remove all sharp protrusions, which may pierce the membrane
Any voids, potholes in the substrate must be appropriately filled up with a high strength mortar refer to Sika Monotop® mortars.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > Concrete
s: All new concrete slabs must have a wood float finish and be allowed to cure for 28 days. (refer to priming details for early aged concrete)
Old concrete must be cleaned with a strong commercial grade detergent or degreaser. Residue must then be thoroughly washed off with clean water. Allow the surface to dry for at least 24 hours
All laitance and efflorescence must be removed prior to application.

cl.t: Substrate quality - Cement based Renders & Screeds
cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > Cement based Renders & Screeds
s: Renders and screeds should have a wood float finish and be allow to cure for 5-7. (refer priming details for early aged green screeds)

cl.t: Substrate quality - Cement Boards and Sheets
cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > Cement Boards and Sheets
s: All boards and sheet shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and be specifically designed for tiling applications.
Screw and nail heads must be treated with a Sika® Neutral cure silicone or Sika® Fillet Joint.
All sheet joints, seams, penetrations, and wall floor junctions shall have a Sika® Neutral cure silicone, Sikaflex® Fillet Joint or Sika SealTape F flexible waterproofing bandage.

cl.t: Substrate preparation - Static Cracks - not subject to movement
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation > Static Cracks - not subject to movement
s: Small hairline cracks, up to 1mm wide, may be filled by the first application of SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof
For cracks / joints wider than 1mm, a joint filler should be applied along the length of the crack prior to the application of SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof

cl.t: Substrate preparation - Non Dymanic Cracks - less than 3mm subject to movement
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation > Non Dymanic Cracks - less than 3mm subject to movement
s: All cracks / joints, irrespective of their width, must be filled firstly with the bond breaker sealant. Then
50mm wide polyethylene / polypropylene tape should be placed over the crack, ensuring it adheres to the surface. Apply the SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof over the tape as per installation instructions.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation > Bond Breaker
cl.x: SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof has high extensibility and is designed for use with a 12 mm bond breaker, a bead of Sika® Neutral cure silicone, Sika® Fillet Joint or a suitable Sika® flexible waterproofing bandage. The sealant applied must be tooled off to form a 12 mm wide bond breaker. A bond breaker must be installed at areas subject to movement, wall/wall junction, wall/floor junction, sheet joints and seams, penetrations and where there is a change in the direction or substrate type.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation > Falls to Drains
cl.x: All areas shall have falls in accordance with National Construction Code (NCC) requirements.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2026, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools > Standard Application
s: 1. SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof requires no mixing. Apply directly from the pail. Use a brush or roller to apply the first coat of SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof on the area to be waterproofed.
2. Allow the first coat to dry for approximately 2-3 hours before applying the 2nd coat at 90° to the first coat. Ensure there are no imperfections on the waterproofing membrane.
3. Apply a third coat if necessary or required to do so. The minimum dry film thinkness shall be 1.00mm
4. Allow the final coat to dry for at least 8 hours prior to tiling application

cl.t: Application method / tools - Application under Pedestall & Paver application
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools > Application under Pedestall & Paver application
s: 1. SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof requires no mixing. Apply directly from the pail. Use a brush or roller to apply the first coat of SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof on the area to be waterproofed.
2. Allow the first coat to dry for approximately 2-3 hours before applying the 2nd coat at 90° to the first coat. Ensure there are no imperfections on the waterproofing membrane.
3. Apply a third coatas (as additional wear layer for pedestall and paver application.
4. The minimum dry film thickness for under pedestall and paver shall be 1.6mm
5. Allow the final coat to dry for at least 24 hours prior to pedestall and paver application
Drying times are influence by factors beyond the control of the manufacturer, use drying times as a guide only.

cl.t: Application method / tools - Flood testing (if required)
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools > Flood testing (if required)
s: Allow SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof to dry and cure for a minimum 72 hours at 23°C and 50% relative humidity for standard applications, and 96 hours at 23°C and 50% relative humidity for paver and pedestall application.
Conduct flood test for 24 hours at max 50mm depth with water.
Inspect membrane for water loss, release water and allow area to dry prior prior to subsequent coatings
Repair membrane if required.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment immediately after us with water. Once cured, residual material can only be removed mechanically.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Important Considerations
s: SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof is not suitable for applications in areas of permanent water immersion.
SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof is not suitable for applications in area of negative hydrostatic pressure or rising damp. Seek sika technical advice.
Delay applications if rain or inclement weather is imminent.
SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof must be applied at the recommended coverage rates.
Tongue & groove timber flooring must be over sheeted with fibre cement sheeting or ceramic tile underlay.
Partical board flooring shall be adequately prepared with all contaminates removed and over sheeted with a suitable ceramic tile underlay or reinforced screed.
To minimise the chance of damage install finished covering as soon as possible once the membrane has cured.
SikaTile®-110 Secure Proof must not be used as a wearing surface for foot and vehicular traffic.
Contact Sika® for information or applications not mentioned in the document.
